cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Try this banking-delay explanation for the missing raffle money on the chair before I sign it. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Just test the explanation. If she accepts it, I'll sign and handle every question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll recognise your handwriting before I speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the paper. Ask whether a banking delay sounds plausible. If she asks whose money, come back before answering.

mechanism: A directs completion of a raffle report but sends B to test its risky explanation first, narrowing B exposure while postponing A signature until feedback.
confusable: Unlike simply asking B to endorse a fixed story, A requires a trial response before committing; authority offers to handle later questions and changes the test method.
comparison: An unsigned account explanation and recognizable handwriting differ from probing a parent reaction to flight costs.
seedUse: D128-a banking delay, chair and paper recognition; S02-b modifies the proposed assignment around B refusal and practical warning.
